**Total web tokens classified: 341** (expected 341). Unexpected unmapped colour tokens: 0.

## Requires manual Figma configuration

- Create the collections, modes and variables (script or by hand); there is no import that this project has tested.
- Create the 21 Text Styles and bind family, weight and size to variables; set line height and letter spacing in the style.
- Create the 3 Effect Styles and 3 Grid Styles.
- Install or enable the fonts **Cormorant** (Medium, SemiBold) and **DM Sans** (Regular, Medium, SemiBold). The web system self-hosts Latin subsets; Figma uses its font library.
- Build the components from [../../01-Design-System/Figma-Specification/components.md](../../01-Design-System/Figma-Specification/components.md).
